product.name: Employee Engagement
product.description: An employee listening and survey solution that measures engagement, segments feedback, identifies key drivers, and supports HR-led action planning.

product.name: Employee Experience
product.description: A survey and analysis solution for identifying friction across employee workflows and touchpoints, including onboarding, systems, policies, equipment, and workplace processes.

product.name: Organizational Health Surveys
product.description: A survey solution that assesses organizational health through measures such as innovation, accountability, culture, and organizational dynamics, with benchmarking and improvement analysis.

product.name: Leadership 360
product.description: A data-driven leadership feedback solution designed to help leaders understand how their leadership is perceived and identify areas for development.

identifier.value: Employee Listening Implementation and Advisory Services

product.name: Employee Listening Implementation and Advisory Services
product.description: Hands-on support for survey design, implementation, analysis, manager enablement, and action planning across employee engagement and experience programs.
